title: Investigating and Extending Homans’ Social Exchange Theory with Large Language Model based Agents

layout.note: Six equal rectangular cards in two rows of three, each with a full-width pastel title band and a black frame; the vignettes inside differ (bars, cloud, token sums, paired bubbles, table) but share the same two recurring cartoon characters.

lesson: Present a set of parallel concepts as equal framed cards, each with a pastel title band and a toy scene played by the same recurring characters, with one short speech bubble stating the idea, so a theory reads as six small stories.
